goals.currentDescriptionEn: The learner can perform and evaluate complexometric titrations with EDTA solution to determine concentrations of metal cations in aqueous solutions.

goals.currentDescriptionEn: The learner can explain the effect of acid-base buffers, select suitable buffer systems for setting pH values of aqueous solutions, and evaluate applications in medicine, environment, and technology using source critique.
